_comment: Blood Debt is PRINTED and handled generically (CR 8.3.11, ability_keywords.blood_debt via triggers.py) -- it is 'while this is in your banished zone, at the beginning of your end phase, lose 1{h}', NOT a cost to play. It had been authored as an additional_cost PAY_LIFE 2, which is wrong three times over: the wrong amount, the wrong timing, and -- because a cost blocks play legality -- it made the card unplayable at 2 or less life, which nothing about the card says. The SET_FLAG BLOOD_DEBT_FLAG beside it was read by nothing.
